description: Use when you need a qr code generator for a URL, text, Wi-Fi or payment link as an SVG image. Do not use for reading or decoding an existing QR code, logos, colored codes or PNG output. Returns JSON with a QR code for your text or URL as SVG markup and an SVG data URL, with error correction level and border options, generated by the uqr library for 0.004 USDC per call. Typical response time 500 ms (p95). Category: Media. Price: US$0.004 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

border.description: Quiet zone around the code, in modules (default 2)

ecc.description: Error correction level: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30%

text.description: Text or URL to encode, e.g. https://example.com (up to 2000 characters)

name: blackwood_qrcode_generate
title: QR code
